verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5080 is a discrete graphics card, a hardware component. It does not hold a user's account data, so exporting all of your data in open formats and leaving is a category error for this kind of product. The NVENC 'video exports' mention is about hardware video encoding, not data portability, and does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
